methodology.scope: A new, separate prospective research simulation for an already registered, historically rejected candidate. Never restart or read old paused shadow ledgers,connect a broker or promote the source candidate.
methodology.registration: Freeze the initial target receipt and register before its first future hypothetical execution open. Initial cash is a bookkeeping anchor only,not backdated investment or interest.
methodology.observations: Each modelled session requires its own actually captured parent snapshot and target-observation receipt. Missing sessions cannot be recovered from historical rows in later downloads; processing can occur later only if the original receipts were captured on time.
methodology.timing: Use only target records generated before the applicable next-open or extra-delay model fill. Base and stress accounts share USD10,000 initial capital,USD1 commissions and their respective cost/delay assumptions. SPY accounts use the same initial timing and execution costs.
methodology.vintage: Chain the adjusted open/close ratios measured against the previous close within each actually acquired daily snapshot. This removes arbitrary total-return price-level renormalization across snapshots without inventing returns. Units are normalized model units,not broker shares. A changed previous raw-close quote pauses accounting for source/corporate-action review rather than silently rewriting history.
methodology.verification: Rebuild the entire observed path with the frozen funded-account simulator and independent bt before appending. Earlier account records must agree with replay; all source and target receipt hashes remain bound.
methodology.inference: Before63real account sessions,do not report a Sharpe estimate. Even later simulated performance is not live performance,complete search-bias correction or research-champion qualification. Historical gates remain failed and the investment objective remains unverified.
methodology.limitations: Fractional normalized units,modelled next-open fills,model fees and no personal taxes; quote revisions and missing observations can pause the study. Recording a target is not a fill,and modelled fills are not orders or actual execution.
